howto: Press Play. Pick LEVELS (a tower with a finish and three stars) or ENDLESS (the old best-score run).
Tap (or press Space) to smash down through the platform below the ball.
Blue and purple parts break, green bounces you through for a combo, red and orange end the run.
Reach the gold star at the bottom to clear the level; the three stars are: reach the finish, hit the combo goal, finish under the par time.
Coins from every run buy ball skins; new balls also unlock from stars, levels and day streaks.
tips: Each platform spins at its own speed: watch the front edge, not the ball.
Green bounces chain into combos worth more with every bounce.
Every five levels the tower changes world (five palettes) and gets longer, faster and busier with red parts.
A daily goal (gems, platforms smashed or levels cleared) pays coins once a day; playing on consecutive days lights the week stamps.
A shield blocks one red or orange landing. The magnet pulls gems in for a few seconds.

controls.keyboard: Space or Down arrow smashes. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: Level N has 12+2N platforms (up to 70), up to four red or orange parts per platform from level 15, a faster spin every level and a new world every five levels. Endless keeps the adaptive curve.

cheats.effect: Iron ball: red and orange break like the rest
Shield up: every run starts with 3 shields
Big ball: a giant ball that grabs gems from further away

features.one-tap-start: Play, then the first tap smashes and starts the run
features.instant-restart: Play Again on the Shattered card starts a new run at once
features.best-score-badge: Best pill in the top bar during play, and on the Shattered card
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a tapping finger; the first run also explains the colours
features.results: Result card with stars, score, coins earned, gems, best, star goals ticked off and Next Level
features.levels: LEVELS mode: levels 1, 2, 3 ... unlock in order, the level picker shows the stars earned
features.stars: Three stars per level (finish, combo goal, par time), shown on the title, the HUD and the result card
features.worlds: Five worlds with their own sky, light and platform colours (Golden Hour, Lavender Dusk, Ocean Morning, Ember Night, Sand and Sea)
features.unlocks: Nine ball skins: free, stars, coins, level or day-streak unlocks; a badge shows new ones
features.daily-goal: One seeded daily goal with a coin reward, week stamps and a day streak on the title screen

settings.quality: Title screen > GRAPHICS: HIGH / LOW (Low renders at 1x resolution with no shadows, draws 6 platforms below the ball instead of 11 and fewer shards)
